The POSIX regex backend for 
regex-base
.

The main appeal of this backend is that it's very lightweight due to its reliance on the ubiquitous 
POSIX.2 regex
facility that is provided by the standard C library on most POSIX platforms.

See also 
https://wiki.haskell.org/Regular_expressions
for more information.
